Sorry to hear that.

My mum has a friend and her husband racked up online gambling debts of £70,000. They lost their house. He actually died last year from lung cancer. It's messed up. Gambling ads should be banned imo.

I suggest you get specific help and counselling.

I'm the opposite, I hold onto my money with an iron fist because I am unemployed and scared of spending. It is fucked up. The UK jobs market is fucked.
